description: This file defines the Accounts class for vtiger CRM, extending CRMEntity, and includes methods for retrieving related records (campaigns, contacts, opportunities, activities, emails, quotes, invoices, sales orders, tickets, products), hierarchy management, exporting data, and managing relationships. It is a core module file for handling account data and relationships within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: Accounts
classes.description: Represents the Accounts module in vtiger CRM, managing account data, relationships, hierarchy, and export functionalities.

methods.name: Accounts
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger, database connection, and column fields.

methods.description: Placeholder for module-specific save operations.

methods.name: get_activities

methods.name: get_invoices

methods.name: get_salesorder
